title: Six CodeQL Alerts, Two Fixes
description: Alert 406: announce-release.mjs printed the resolved HQ_API_TOKEN_REFERENCE op:// path on the 401 path, a name-level disclosure into public CI logs. The variable read and the workflow passthrough are removed, and the message names the repository variable and nothing else. Alerts 385 to 389: the lab page escaped only ampersand and angle brackets before interpolating values into HTML attributes; escapeAttr now covers all five attribute-significant characters at every attribute interpolation. Two new tests fail on either regression. The page lets you probe both escapers live.
